ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

input.description: Styling and integration directive for native <input> text-like fields. Works standalone and integrated with Form Field.

examples.note: Standalone input with its own visual shell: border, background, padding, radius, and focus ring.

form-field.label: Name
form-field.note: Label, hint, and visual shell managed by Form Field. Input keeps behavior, placeholder, and value. Size on Form Field is valid and owns the outer height through the 3x3 matrix.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the input directive with Form Field.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: Radius is owned by Form Field when projected; the standalone input exposes the same none, sm, md, lg, and xl values. Global scale: md maps to 4px, lg to 8px, and xl renders as a pill.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: Form Field owns the outer height, the input keeps its own font and padding in sync.

input.title: Input

types.note: Native type semantics are preserved. Unsupported types (file, color, range, checkbox, radio, buttons, hidden) warn in development.
